symbols.name: ground set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements in the ground set $[h]$, which is 100.
symbols.quote: Let $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$ be the ground set, with $h=100$ (the letter $h$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set $[h]$.
symbols.quote: A three-element subset $T$ of $[h]$ is a *triple*, and $\mathcal T$ is the set of all triples.

symbols.name: set of triples
symbols.meaning: The set of all three-element subsets of the ground set.
symbols.quote: A three-element subset $T$ of $[h]$ is a *triple*, and $\mathcal T$ is the set of all triples.

symbols.name: triple value
symbols.meaning: The value carried by the triple $T$, which the network moves to the triples it reaches.

symbols.name: ground element
symbols.meaning: An element of the ground set $[h]$, indexing one central wire.
symbols.quote: gather puts the sum of the $g_T$ with $e\in T$ on a central wire $C_e$ for each element $e$ of $[h]$

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The central wire for element $e$, which carries the sum of the $g_T$ over triples $T$ containing $e$.
symbols.quote: gather puts the sum of the $g_T$ with $e\in T$ on a central wire $C_e$ for each element $e$ of $[h]$

symbols.name: auxiliary wire
symbols.meaning: The auxiliary wire for a neighbor pair $S,T$, which carries a copy of $g_T$ into $S$.
symbols.quote: For each neighbor pair, an auxiliary wire $A_{ST}$ carries a copy of $g_T$ into $S$, which adds a further $g_T$ to $S$ exactly when $|S\cap T|=1$.

symbols.name: all-one matrix
symbols.meaning: The $h\times h$ matrix with every entry equal to 1.
symbols.quote: Let $J$ be the all-one $h\times h$ matrix (the letter $J$ changes meaning here), and let the bilinear form on $\mathbb Q^h$ have matrix $I-J/9$.

symbols.name: label space
symbols.meaning: The space $(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$ in which the labels are subspaces.
symbols.quote: The label space $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$ is built from the [Tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md) of three copies of $\mathbb Q^h$, with the product form, and has dimension $D=h^3$, which is the paper's $m$ (the letter $m$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: label space dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the label space $\mathcal F$, which is $h^3$.
symbols.quote: The label space $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$ is built from the [Tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md) of three copies of $\mathbb Q^h$, with the product form, and has dimension $D=h^3$, which is the paper's $m$ (the letter $m$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: source index
symbols.meaning: An index $(T_1,T_2,T_3)$ of three triples, which labels one source and one line.
symbols.quote: For an index $\iota=(T_1,T_2,T_3)\in\mathcal T^3$, the label $U_\iota$ is the line spanned by $t_{T_1}\otimes t_{T_2}\otimes t_{T_3}$, and $N=\binom h3^3$ counts the indices $\iota$.

symbols.name: index label
symbols.meaning: The label, a line in the label space, spanned by the tensor product of the three indicator vectors of $\iota$.
symbols.quote: For an index $\iota=(T_1,T_2,T_3)\in\mathcal T^3$, the label $U_\iota$ is the line spanned by $t_{T_1}\otimes t_{T_2}\otimes t_{T_3}$, and $N=\binom h3^3$ counts the indices $\iota$.

symbols.name: index count
symbols.meaning: The number of indices $\iota$, which is the cube of the number of triples.
symbols.quote: For an index $\iota=(T_1,T_2,T_3)\in\mathcal T^3$, the label $U_\iota$ is the line spanned by $t_{T_1}\otimes t_{T_2}\otimes t_{T_3}$, and $N=\binom h3^3$ counts the indices $\iota$.

symbols.name: label projection
symbols.meaning: The projection onto the label $U$ along its orthogonal complement $U^\perp$.
symbols.quote: Each gate or sink with label $U$ carries the projection $P_U$ onto $U$ along $U^\perp$, and the source of index $\iota$ carries $-P_{U_\iota}$.

symbols.name: larger label
symbols.meaning: A label that contains the label $U$ in the rank count.
symbols.quote: If $U\subseteq V$ for labels $U$ and $V$ (here $V$ is a label), then $P_V-P_U$ is the identity on $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero on $U\oplus V^\perp$, so its rank is $\dim V-\dim U$.

symbols.name: total rank
symbols.meaning: The sum of the ranks of the edge differences over all edges, which counts the smaller calls.
symbols.quote: Each edge carries the difference of its endpoint matrices, and $s$ is the sum of the ranks of these differences over all edges.

symbols.name: lost dimension
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost on decreasing edges, the edges whose label shrinks.
symbols.quote: Let $L$ be the total dimension lost on decreasing edges, the edges whose label shrinks (the letter $L$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: paper dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the fixed space in the paper's bound, equal to $D$ here.
symbols.quote: The label space $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$ is built from the [Tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md) of three copies of $\mathbb Q^h$, with the product form, and has dimension $D=h^3$, which is the paper's $m$ (the letter $m$ changes meaning here).
